```plato

    // The two arrays joined end to end.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concatenation)
    Concatenate(xs: Array<$T>, ys: Array<$T>): Array<$T>
        => MapRange(xs.Count + ys.Count, i => i < xs.Count ? xs[i] : ys[i - xs.Count]);
```
